annotations.title: AI summary of text or a web page

description: AI summary of up to 8,000 characters of text, or of a public web page URL (main content fetched through SSRF-validated redirects and converted to Markdown, first 30,000 characters). Length short, medium or long; format paragraph, bullets or json. Returns summary, key points, detected language, source URL and title, input size and truncation flag. Generated by Anthropic Claude under a fixed Kit Rx prompt; AI-generated text may omit or misstate details. Price: $0.006 per successful call, paid in USDC with x402 v2; failed calls and calls that match nothing are not charged. AI-generated answer; a call with no arguments returns the stored example answer without a model call.

format.description: paragraph (prose, default), bullets (summary as a Markdown bullet list) or json (plain-text summary without Markdown; key_points as standalone factual sentences).

length.description: short (one or two sentences, up to 3 key points), medium (about 80-150 words, 3-5 key points, default) or long (about 250-400 words, 5-8 key points).

text.description: Text to summarize, up to 8000 characters (URL-encoded). Give text or url, not both.
examples: The city council voted 7-2 on Tuesday to approve a $48 million bond for road repairs...

url.description: http or https URL of a public page to summarize instead of text. Default ports only; credentials, IP addresses, localhost and private or single-label names are rejected.

name: text_summarize
